## Summary

Describe the documentation or governance change.

## Evidence

List the source, date, release tag, or mechanical check supporting each factual claim.

## Checklist

- [ ] No product source or unreviewed binary is included.
- [ ] No secret, cookie, one-time code, private key, private log, or personal data is included.
- [ ] Chinese and English statements remain aligned where applicable.
- [ ] Legacy Preview failures remain prominent and are not described as supported production features.
- [ ] DeepSeek names are used only for upstream compatibility/provenance, with no official-affiliation claim.
